company.name: JumpWire
company.shortDescription: JumpWire makes it easy to enforce secure data practices across applications without having to change any code.
company.description:
JumpWire makes it easy to enforce secure data practices across applications without having to change any code. By proxying requests to databases and APIs and inspecting their schemas and payloads, JumpWire automatically identifies fields that need special handling. JumpWire will transform the data in place (for example encrypting any field that is classified as PII). This ensures that further processing or storage won’t risk leaking the data in its raw form inadvertently.

A common use case for JumpWire is moving data between internal databases and tools for analytics and customer support. In this scenario, specific columns (such as those corresponding to PII) may need special handling before loading into another tool with a more permissive access concept.

JumpWire installs on-premise or inside our customer’s own cloud, so there is no dependency on a third party or concern with sharing data outside the network.

productsAndServices.description: Ensures all queries contain filter clauses and provides guardrails for queries generated by third-party software and LLMs.
productsAndServices.name: Enforced Query Filters

productsAndServices.name: Transparent Data Routing
